t.zh: 饱和器每一圈把每一对都消一遍，大部分新子句用不上。这些子句每条至多一个不带 ¬ 的文字，叫 Horn 子句。
t.en: Each round the saturator cancels every pair, and most new clauses go unused. In these clauses each has at most one literal without ¬: they are Horn clauses.

after.zh: SAT 求解器里，这叫<wiki-ref to="unit"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: In a SAT solver this is called <wiki-ref to="unit"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手推出 ⊥，子句的条数不能超过每组测试的限额。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that reaches ⊥ without making more clauses than each test allows.

hint.zh: 有几条子句一开始就只有一个文字。
hint.en: Some clauses have a single literal from the start.

hint.zh: 只有一个文字的子句，就是已经被迫的事。
hint.en: A one-literal clause is something already forced.
